Most people who end up in assisted living after a devastating fall never realize their body gave them three quiet warnings before it was too late.

Here's what we observed across thousands of fall incident reports:

1️⃣ Shuffling feet and grabbing furniture when walking around the house (loss of ground feel)

2️⃣ Feeling unsteady on uneven surfaces like gravel, grass, or stairs (proprioception failure)

3️⃣ Near-slips that "come out of nowhere" -- you didn't feel your foot sliding until it was too late (sensory delay)

Many people report them for years.
